connect.title: Link your game • Bloomshire Companion
connect.o1Title: 🛡️ Option 1: sign in with your wallet (Web3)
connect.o1Body: Sign a message with your wallet (MetaMask, Rabby or your browser's) to prove it's yours. No gas fee. It protects your cloud save so nobody else can see or overwrite your data.
connect.o1Button: 🔐 Connect and sign with your wallet (Web3)
connect.o2Body: The Bloomshire Companion extension reads your game in your browser, instantly:
connect.o2Note: ℹ️ Note: the extension syncs your game. To unlock the locked modules (Timers, Quests and Copilot), sign with your wallet in Option 1.
connect.o2Step1: Install the extension in Chrome, Brave or Edge.
connect.o2Step3: The tool picks up your inventory, gold and crops in under a second.
connect.o3Body: Enter a wallet (0x...) to see its public NFTs in read-only mode (nothing is changed):
connect.help: Questions? Check the guide in the Mega-Atlas.
